_comment: Runtimes LINA installs for itself (lina#32, lina#34), read by hermes_cli/lina_ocx.py and hermes_cli/lina_omo.py. Node serves OCX, omo and ocx-omo (>= 24); its sha256 per platform comes from nodejs.org/dist/v<version>/SHASUMS256.txt. The OCX and omo integrity is npm's dist.integrity for that exact version; tests/hermes_cli/test_lina_deps_pin.py checks it against the registry.
